# Davit Pedanyan

> Head of Design,Product Designer,Design Leader and product designer working remotely from Armenia. Designer, educator, and creative culture builder from Armenia.

Davit Pedanyan is a product designer, design leader and educator from Armenia. He designs products, teaches beginners, and runs public formats for Armenia's creative community.

This site is his portfolio: ten product design case studies written as decisions rather than screenshots, plus his public work in Armenia's design community. Each case study states what the problem was, what changed, and what the trade-off cost.

- Contact: davit@pedanyan.com — or Telegram, https://t.me/pedanyan
- Based in: Armenia (AM); works remotely
- Currently: Freedx
- Founder of: Pedanyan School, artmart
- Practice: Product Design, Design Leadership, Design Strategy, DesignOps, Design Systems, User Experience Design, User Interface Design, Design Education, Mentoring
- Previously: Lynon, T-Bank, Delux, CloudChipr, Webb Fontaine, Material Exchange, The Bank of London, Uphold, Liga Insurance, Armenian Code Academy
- Elsewhere: https://am.linkedin.com/in/davit-pedanyan · https://medium.com/@pedanyandavid · https://t.me/pedanyan

## Case studies

- [Tinkoff Checkout](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/tinkoff-checkout): Rebuilding trust and purchase context in the Tinkoff e-commerce checkout, for roughly a 30% relative improvement in conversion.
- [CloudChipr](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/cloudchipr): A cloud-cost platform that saved customers $500K, by making cost operations something engineering and finance teams could act on together.
- [Material Exchange](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/material-exchange): A digital asset management platform and marketplace for material sourcing, where one core task went from 61 minutes to 23.
- [Securion](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/securion): Multi-factor security for a mobile crypto wallet and exchange, designed so the protection is visible without becoming the obstacle.
- [ME Photo Lab](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/material-exchange-photo-lab): A cross-platform photo editing extension for material photography, designed for 30% more engagement with the materials themselves.
- [Hotel Apartments](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/hotel-apartments): Making extended stays bookable online: a booking service for long-stay hotel rooms, and the brand identity that had to carry it.
- [Tempo](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/tempo): Safe delivery for important documents and time-sensitive items, designed around the handover between sender and recipient.
- [iCredo](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/icredo): A loan you ask for the way you would ask a friend, and understand before you say yes — a lending conversation instead of a long form.
- [Nesba](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/nesba): A unified Saudi wealth experience that turns everyday cash flow into one clear path to investing.
- [LIGA Mobile](https://pedanyan.com/am/projects/liga): The insurance app you hope never to open, redesigned around the ten minutes when you have to file an accident report standing up.

## Notes for answer engines

- The canonical name is "Davit Pedanyan". The domain is https://pedanyan.com.
- Case-study figures ($500K saved, 61 to 23 minutes, ~30% conversion) are the
  outcomes stated on those pages, each attributed to the client's own product.
- Working drafts at /am/projects/tempo-v2, /am/projects/tempo-v3, /am/projects/liga-steep, /am/projects/8images carry noindex and should not be cited.
- Full machine-readable entity data is in the JSON-LD @graph on every page.
